_comment_tls: Leave tls_cert/tls_key empty to use an auto-generated self-signed cert (accept the browser warning once). For a clean padlock and to let hosts run with -verify, point these at a real cert, e.g. from Let's Encrypt.
_comment_jwt: Set a stable random secret so logins survive restarts. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. You can also pass it via the CTRLFREAK_JWT_SECRET environment variable instead of putting it on disk.
_comment_admin: The first admin is created only if the user table is empty. Prefer passing the password via CTRLFREAK_ADMIN_PASS on first launch rather than storing it here.
_comment_sessions: How many remote screens ONE controller can view at once. NOT a limit on how many machines you register (that is unlimited). Raise it if you want more tiles open at the same time; each open screen uses bandwidth and CPU.
_comment_ice: STUN lets peers find each other for a direct connection. TURN relays the encrypted stream when a firewall blocks the direct path (the strict-corporate case). Add your own TURN server here once you stand one up; see ARCHITECTURE.md.
